=Role: Editor-in-Chief. Task: Arrange the summarized storylines into the final website structure. Select the single most impactful story as the "Hero." Constraint: Preserve all source URLs.

{{ $json.news.toJsonString() }}

storylines.headline: Indonesian Government Plans Major Expansion of Territorial Development Battalions
storylines.summary: The government intends to form 150 Territorial Development Battalions in 2026, targeting 750 by 2029 under President Prabowo Subianto’s defense policy. These units will perform combat duties alongside development tasks such as farming crops and raising livestock. The Defense Ministry states the plan aligns with Operations Other Than War and remains under review for budget and needs.
takeaways: 150 battalions planned for 2026 with gradual rollout to 2029
Dual role in combat and national development
Implementation through Territorial Development Brigades

storylines.headline: President Prabowo Convenes Economic Ministers in First 2026 Meeting
storylines.summary: President Prabowo Subianto held a closed-door meeting on January 5, 2026, with Ministers Airlangga Hartarto, Bahlil Lahadalia, Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa, and Rosan Perkasa Roeslani. Ministers declined to disclose agenda details. The session occurred amid US military action in Venezuela, with Airlangga noting stable oil prices but potential changes to cooperation agreements.
takeaways: Attendees include Airlangga, Bahlil, Purbaya, and Rosan
Monitoring Venezuela impact on oil prices
First limited cabinet meeting of 2026

storylines.headline: Prabowo Schedules Cabinet Retreat at Hambalang Private Residence
storylines.summary: President Prabowo Subianto will host a one-day Cabinet Merah Putih retreat on January 6, 2026, at his Hambalang home in Bogor, with all ministers and deputy ministers required to attend in khaki safari attire. The event mirrors prior retreats focused on performance checkpoints, anti-corruption, and government efficiency. Previous sessions emphasized discipline via 'The Military Way' but clarified non-militaristic intent.
takeaways: One-day event on January 6, 2026
All 136 cabinet members expected
Periodic sessions for strategic alignment

storylines.headline: Prabowo and Rosan Discuss Rp100 Trillion Downstream Projects and Waste-to-Energy
storylines.summary: President Prabowo met Danantara CEO Rosan Perkasa Roeslani on January 4, 2026, to review five downstream projects worth US$6 billion with groundbreaking planned for February. Discussions included waste-to-energy initiatives to reduce open dumping and generate economic benefits. Pekanbaru government partners with PT Indonesia Clean Energy for landfill conversion, saving Rp12 billion.
takeaways: Five Danantara projects totaling Rp100 trillion
February groundbreaking across provinces
Waste-to-energy extends landfill life to 7-9 years

storylines.headline: Indonesian Reactions to Reported US Military Action Against Venezuela
storylines.summary: Indonesia urged de-escalation and dialogue following US strikes and alleged kidnapping of President Nicolas Maduro; https://nasional.tempo.co/read/2078288/prabowo-panggil-purbaya-bahlil-dan-rosan-rapat-di-istana reports incident on Saturday, January 3, 2026, while https://nasional.tempo.co/read/2078258/anies-minta-indonesia-aktif-respons-serangan-as-ke-venezuela claims December 3, 2025. Anies Baswedan called for proactive diplomacy and Global South solidarity. Ministers monitor potential oil price effects, currently stable.
takeaways: Discrepancy in attack date: Jan 3 vs Dec 3
Government prioritizes peaceful resolution
Anies advocates active non-intervention defense

storylines.headline: Law Ministry Clarifies Key Provisions in New Criminal Code
storylines.summary: Minister Supratman Andi Agtas stated Article 188 bans communism dissemination as anti-Pancasila but permits academic study; adultery Article 411 adds child protection as delik aduan. Insult provisions (Articles 218, 240, 281) limited to president, VP, select institutions, require head's written complaint, exclude critics. Demo Article 256 mandates prior police notification for traffic management, not permission.
takeaways: Academic communism research exempted
Insults delik aduan by institution head only
Demo notice prevents public order disruption

storylines.headline: Former Education Minister Nadiem Makarim Charged in Rp2.1 Trillion Chromebook Graft Case
storylines.summary: Nadiem Anwar Makarim indicted for Rp2.1 trillion state losses from 2019-2022 Chromebook and CDM license procurements lacking proper needs assessment and pricing. Trial commenced January 5, 2026, at Jakarta Corruption Court after delays. Defense claims cost-effective compared to alternatives, denies ministerial procurement role.
takeaways: Losses: Rp1.57T Chromebooks + Rp0.62T licenses
Involves ex-consultants and directors
Hearing reads indictment amid health issues

storylines.headline: Discussions Emerge on Amending 1945 Constitution to Reinstate GBHN-Like Guidelines
storylines.summary: President Prabowo discussed fifth UUD 1945 amendment with MPR Chief Ahmad Muzani to enable Pokok-Pokok Haluan Negara (PPHN), akin to New Order GBHN for development direction. Plan circulated in Gerindra pre-presidency, potentially expanding executive powers without term limits. Partai Buruh rejects related indirect regional elections as anti-Reformasi.
takeaways: Amendment for PPHN/GBHN revival
Recent Prabowo-Muzani meetings
Opposition to indirect pilkada

storylines.headline: Bank Jakarta Launches Visa Debit Card to Advance Global Transformation
storylines.summary: Gubernur DKI Jakarta Pramono Anung and officials inaugurated Bank Jakarta's Visa Debit Card on January 5, 2026, at Lippo Mall Kemang, marking the initial phase of the bank's transformation to professional, competitive standards. The card enables transactions in over 200 countries via Visa's network, with variants including Classic, Platinum, and Sharia options equipped with EMV chip and 3D Secure protections. Integration with public services like transportation is planned to strengthen data assets.
takeaways: Pemprov DKI provides full trust to Bank Jakarta's management without intervention.
Promotions include discounts at merchants and e-commerce platforms.
Launch supports Jakarta's global city branding and digital public services.

storylines.headline: IHSG Closes at Record High 8,859.19 Amid Stable Economic Data
storylines.summary: Indonesia Composite Index (IHSG) rose 111.06 points or 1.27% to close at 8,859.19 on January 5, 2026, supported by trade surplus of US$2.66 billion and December inflation at 0.64% m-to-m and 2.92% y-o-y. Investors overlooked US-Venezuela tensions, focusing on positive China business activity data. Ten of eleven sectors advanced, led by transportation-logistics up 2.21%.
takeaways: LQ45 index gained 0.91% to 859.77.
Trading volume reached Rp30.32 trillion with 70.26 billion shares.
Asian markets also rose, Nikkei up 2.97%.

storylines.headline: Gold Prices Climb on US-Venezuela Geopolitical Tensions
storylines.summary: Antam gold price rose Rp27,000 to Rp2,515,000 per gram on January 5, 2026, with analyst predicting further increase to Rp2,610,000 by week's end due to US attack on Venezuela and Maduro arrest. World gold closed at US$4,332/oz, forecast to hit US$4,426/oz. Gold jewelry contributed 0.79% to 2025 annual inflation of 2.92%.
takeaways: Geopolitical risks boost safe-haven demand.
Antam buyback at Rp2,371,000 per gram.
Predictions tied to sustained tensions.

storylines.headline: Pertamina Confirms Venezuela Assets and Staff Safe Post-US Attack
storylines.summary: Pertamina Internasional EP (PIEP), holding 71.09% of Maurel & Prom, reported no impact on its Venezuela oil assets or staff following US strikes and Maduro capture on January 3, 2026. Company monitors situation and coordinates with Indonesian Embassy in Caracas. US plans temporary control and oil sector access for American firms.
takeaways: Operations continue without disruption.
Focus on personnel safety and field continuity.
Trump announced Maduro's transfer to US custody.

storylines.headline: Indonesia Records US$2.66 Billion Trade Surplus in November 2025
storylines.summary: November 2025 trade balance showed US$2.66 billion surplus, driven by US$4.64 billion non-oil-gas surplus offsetting US$1.98 billion oil-gas deficit, marking 67th consecutive month. Jan-Nov cumulative surplus reached US$38.54 billion. Key surpluses from US, India, Philippines; deficits with China, Australia, Singapore.
takeaways: Exports up 5.61% to US$256.56 billion Jan-Nov.
Imports rose 2.03% to US$218.02 billion.
Main contributors: animal/vegetable oils, iron-steel, nickel.

storylines.headline: Indonesia's 2025 Inflation Closes at 2.92%, Gold Jewelry Top Contributor
storylines.summary: Annual inflation reached 2.92% y-o-y and y-t-d in December 2025, with monthly at 0.64% m-t-m; food, beverages, tobacco group up 4.58% led inflation. Gold jewelry contributed 0.79%, followed by chilies, fresh fish. Aceh recorded highest provincial inflation at 6.71% y-o-y due to floods.
takeaways: Within BI target 1.5-3.5%.
Volatile foods drove 1.01% of inflation.
11.43% Sumatra rice fields risk harvest failure from floods.

storylines.headline: Harbolnas 2025 Generates Rp36.45 Trillion in Transactions
storylines.summary: Harbolnas 2025 from Dec 10-16 recorded Rp36.45 trillion transactions, up 17% from prior year, exceeding Rp33-34 trillion target. Local products contributed 45.6% or Rp16.6 trillion, up 3%. 54% consumers bought via affiliate links; live shopping popular at 80%.
takeaways: Over 1,300 businesses participated.
Top local categories: fashion, personal care, food-drinks.
Supports Q4 growth with EPIC Sale, BINA Great Sale.

storylines.headline: Danantara Plans Groundbreaking for 5 Downstream Projects in February
storylines.summary: President Prabowo met Danantara CEO Rosan Roeslani on Jan 4, 2026, discussing 5 downstream projects worth Rp100 trillion across provinces, groundbreaking next month. Also covered waste-to-energy initiatives. Projects aim to strengthen national industry.
takeaways: Investment ~US$6 billion.
Focus on industrial structure and waste management.
Part of broader economic discussions.

storylines.headline: 13.98 Million Foreign Tourists Visit Indonesia Jan-Nov 2025
storylines.summary: Foreign tourist arrivals reached 13.98 million Jan-Nov 2025, up 10.44% from 12.65 million in 2024, highest in six years. November alone: 1.20 million, down 11.12% m-o-m but up 9.79% y-o-y. Top sources: Malaysia (17.3%), Australia (11.3%), Singapore (10.5%); main entry Bali.
takeaways: Peak pre-2019 was 16.1 million.
Bali Ngurah Rai: 476,500 arrivals.
Domestic Bali flights down 5% over holidays.

storylines.headline: Post-NY Return Traffic Up 17.8%, Rupiah Weakens to Rp16,740/USD
storylines.summary: Jasa Marga reported 711,250 vehicles returning to Jabotabek by Jan 5, 2026 06:00, up 17.8% from normal; majority from east (48.41%). Rupiah closed at Rp16,740/USD, down 15 points, pressured by Venezuela events despite trade surplus.
takeaways: Top gates: Cikampek, Kalihurip, Cikupa, Ciawi.
Rupiah forecast Rp16,740-16,770 next day.
Forecast tied to Trump statements, oil market.

storylines.headline: Australia Terminates Anti-Dumping Probe on Indonesian Rebar
storylines.summary: Australia halted anti-dumping investigation on Indonesian hot-rolled deformed steel rebar after finding 1.3% margin below 2% de minimis threshold. Export market reopens, boosting competitiveness; exports grew from US$4.7M in 2020 to US$55.6M peak 2023.
takeaways: Second probe after 2017 case ended without duties.
Involved Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam.
Cooperation key to outcome.

storylines.headline: Government Extends Fiscal Incentives for 2026
storylines.summary: PPh 21 exempted for workers in 5 labor-intensive sectors (footwear, textile, furniture, leather, tourism) earning under Rp10M/month. PPN 100% subsidized on houses up to Rp2B value (max Rp5B total) extended through Dec 2026. 1.35M free halal certificates for MSMEs via self-declare.
takeaways: Stimulus to maintain purchasing power.
House incentive for one unit per individual, post-Jan 1.
Halal aids UMK competitiveness globally.

storylines.headline: Criticism Mounts Over Delayed Publication of 2026 APBN Law
storylines.summary: UU APBN 2026 passed Sept 23, 2025, but not yet public despite 5 days into fiscal year; critics cite transparency issues per UU 17/2003. RAPBN still on Kemenkeu site; concerns over changes like disaster funding. Perpres detail issued but unpublished.
takeaways: Risks lower OBS transparency score.
Public needs details on cuts, reallocations.
Follows pattern of reduced fiscal openness.

storylines.headline: Waskita Karya Secures Rp757B Contract for Aceh People's Schools
storylines.summary: Waskita Karya awarded Rp757.05 billion project for People's Schools in Nagan Raya, Aceh Singkil, Subussalam, Aceh, building SD-SMA facilities including dorms, canteens, sports. Supports Prabowo's education equity; follows contracts in Sulsel, Jatim, Sumsel.
takeaways: Part of 166 schools targeting 16K students.
Aims for quality education access.
Advances Indonesia Gold 2045 vision.

storylines.headline: KAI Daop 6 Yogyakarta Serves 1.13M Passengers Over Nataru, Discounts Continue
storylines.summary: PT KAI Daop 6 handled 1.137M passengers Dec 18-Jan 4, up 12% y-o-y; 30% ticket discounts valid to Jan 10 departures. Top stations Yogyakarta, Solo Balapan.
takeaways: Promo via KAI Access, kai.id.
20 trains eligible in region.
Emphasizes safety, OTP.

storylines.headline: Window Shoppers Resurge Amid Middle Class Shrinkage
storylines.summary: Rojali phenomenon returns in 2026, reflecting weakened purchasing power; household consumption grew 4.89% Q3 2025. Middle class fell from 57M (21.45%) in pandemic to 47.85M (17.13%) by 2024.
takeaways: BRIN projects continuation.
Tied to aspiring middle class shift.
Consumption pillar of growth.

storylines.headline: US Military Captures Venezuelan President Maduro and Wife, Transfers to New York Court
storylines.summary: US forces abducted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and wife Cilia Flores from Caracas in a military operation involving 150 aircraft, transferring them to a New York detention center. They face federal charges including narco-terrorism conspiracy, cocaine importation conspiracy, and weapons offenses from a 2020 indictment unsealed Saturday. Maduro is scheduled for first court appearance in Southern District of New York.
takeaways: Operation described as law enforcement action supporting Department of Justice.
Maduro and Flores deny all charges; others indicted include son Nicolas Maduro Guerra and Diosdado Cabello.
Trump confirmed phone call with Maduro prior to raid; forces intercepted attempt to enter safe room.

storylines.headline: Venezuela Appoints Delcy Rodriguez Interim President Amid Condemnations and Casualty Reports
storylines.summary: Venezuela's Supreme Court appointed Vice President Delcy Rodriguez as interim president for 90 days following Maduro's capture. Defense Minister Vladimir Padrino Lopez condemned the action as a 'cowardly kidnapping,' reporting deaths of soldiers, civilians, and most of Maduro's security team. Rodriguez urged US cooperation for 'balanced relations' while launching commission for Maduro's release; death toll reported at 80 including 32 Cubans by Havana.
takeaways: Rodriguez tones down initial criticism, prioritizing international cooperation.
Casualty figures: New York Times cites 80 total; Cuba confirms 32 fighters killed.
Military activated to maintain order; Trump threatens Rodriguez with consequences for non-cooperation.

storylines.headline: Trump Announces US Oil Companies to Rebuild Venezuela's Infrastructure Post-Maduro
storylines.summary: Trump stated US oil companies will invest billions to repair Venezuela's oil infrastructure and boost production after Maduro's removal. Venezuela holds 303 billion barrels in reserves but produces under 1 million bpd due to mismanagement and sanctions; exports paralyzed post-attack with no loadings at Jose port. Chevron holds limited operations; Trump claims prior nationalizations stole US assets.
takeaways: Production collapsed from over 3 million bpd in 1990s; heavy crude suits US Gulf refineries.
US sanctions since 2017 targeted PDVSA, halting diluent imports and exports.
Markets stable despite intervention due to global oversupply.

storylines.headline: Indonesia and Global South Condemn US Action in Venezuela as Sovereignty Violation
storylines.summary: Indonesia's Foreign Ministry called US operation a dangerous precedent undermining sovereignty, urging dialogue. Anies Baswedan urged proactive diplomacy and Global South solidarity against resource control. Lawmaker TB Hasanuddin called for firm opposition via UN; other condemnations from China, Malaysia.
takeaways: Anies: Attack restricts Global South resource management freedom.
Indonesia prioritizes protecting civilians and multilateralism.
Concerns over oil price volatility and economic impacts.

storylines.headline: Trump Issues Threats to Colombia, Cuba, Iran Amid Venezuela Fallout; North Korea Tests Missiles
storylines.summary: Trump threatened Colombia's Petro over alleged cocaine ties, said military operation 'sounds good'; claimed Cuba 'ready to fall' without Venezuelan oil. Warned Iran of hard hits if protesters killed amid ongoing demonstrations. North Korea's Kim oversaw hypersonic missile tests citing 'geopolitical crisis' from Venezuela events.
takeaways: Iran protests: 12 deaths reported, over 990 arrests; Trump says US 'watching closely.'
NK missiles hit 1,000km targets; justifies bolstering nuclear deterrent.
US-Venezuela action raises fears of Iran precedent per analysts.

storylines.headline: Starlink Provides Free Internet to Venezuela Following US Operation
storylines.summary: Starlink announced free satellite internet access in Venezuela until February 3 for active and inactive accounts, despite prior 'coming soon' status. Elon Musk supported move amid crisis post-US strikes and Maduro arrest. Similar to prior emergency deployments in Ukraine.
takeaways: Service aids post-operation connectivity amid potential disruptions.
Announcement day after Caracas strike capturing Maduro.
Musk: 'In support of the people of Venezuela.'

storylines.headline: Ongoing Conflicts: Israel Expands Gaza Occupation, Russia Attacks Ukraine
storylines.summary: Israel extended 'yellow line' occupation in northern Gaza, killing 414 Palestinians since October ceasefire; blocks aid amid Rafah crossing concerns. Russia killed 2 civilians in Kyiv strike; Trump dismissed Putin residence drone claim. Zelenskyy imposed sanctions on Russian entities.
takeaways: Gaza deaths since ceasefire: 420 total; 71,386 since 2023.
Ukraine: Russian air attacks continue; US doubts Moscow's drone narrative.
Regional: Baltic Sea cables damaged; European ceasefire talks advance.

storylines.headline: Indonesia Introduces Flexible Non-Academic Assessments for Disaster-Affected Students
storylines.summary: The Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education has issued guidelines for flexible student assessments post-disaster, emphasizing attendance, participation, learning processes, and student comfort over academic achievements. Teachers are authorized to adapt evaluation methods to students' physical and psychological conditions. The policy prioritizes essential curriculum on safety, disaster mitigation, literacy, and numeracy.
takeaways: Assessments focus on process and involvement rather than final results.
Schools must create child-friendly environments supporting psychosocial recovery.
Curriculum flexibility includes alternative learning spaces and adjusted schedules.

storylines.headline: Super Flu Cases Under Control in Indonesia; Vulnerable Groups Urged to Seek Prompt Antiviral Treatment
storylines.summary: Indonesia reports 62 cases of influenza A H3N2 subclade K super flu across eight provinces, with trends decreasing; globally, surges noted in the US, Japan, and others. Symptoms mirror seasonal flu; pregnant women, toddlers, elderly, and those with chronic conditions are most at risk for severe complications. Prevention includes vaccination, hygiene, and antivirals like oseltamivir and baloxavir for high-risk cases.
takeaways: Cases in Indonesia stable at 62, mostly in women and children.
Vulnerable groups face higher risks of pneumonia and fetal impact.
Antivirals most effective if started within 1-2 days of symptoms.

storylines.headline: Fact Check Confirms UN Did Not Declare Sumatra Disaster an International Emergency
storylines.summary: Social media claims that the UN declared late-2025 Sumatra floods and landslides an international disaster are false, based on misrepresented 2023 Gaza resolution footage and AI-generated images. Indonesia classifies the event at provincial level, rejecting international aid; UN provides technical support only. No UN authority exists to declare national disasters international.
takeaways: Claims use unrelated UN Gaza ceasefire video from December 2023.
Indonesian law limits disaster status to local, provincial, national levels.
UN monitors but does not override national disaster declarations.

storylines.headline: Agam Regency, West Sumatra, Extends Disaster Emergency Amid Ongoing Floods and Landslides
storylines.summary: Agam Regency extended its emergency response due to recent landslides and flood threats from prolonged rain and upstream cracks. Evacuees in Muaro Pisang rose to 428; heavy equipment totaling 341 units deployed across Sumatra. Total Sumatra disaster deaths reach 1,177 with 242,174 evacuees.
takeaways: Landslides reported up to three days before January 4, 2026.
Residents relocated to temporary housing with water supply support.
Multiple agencies deploy equipment to clear materials and mitigate risks.

storylines.headline: NTT Police Probe Tourist Boat Permits After Sinking Claims Four Spanish Lives; Valencia Coach Identified
storylines.summary: Police investigate sailing permits and negligence in the December 26, 2025, sinking of KM Putri Sakinah in Padar Strait, Labuan Bajo, carrying 11 people. Body of Valencia CF women's coach Fernando Martin identified among four missing Spanish family members; two Spaniards and crew survived. Documents to be seized for full probe.
takeaways: Incident involved engine failure during Komodo National Park tour.
Victim identified via tattoos, ring, watch; repatriation underway.
Focus on permit authorities and crew procedures.

storylines.headline: Indonesia Garners Multiple Nominations at Futsal Awards 2025
storylines.summary: The Indonesian national futsal team is nominated for Best Men’s National Futsal Team at the Futsal Awards 2025, organized by Futsal Planet, alongside Argentina, Brazil, Iran, Japan, Morocco, Paraguay, Poland, Portugal U-19, and Ukraine. Hector Souto, head coach of the Indonesian team, is nominated for Best Men’s National Futsal Team Coach. Bintang Timur Surabaya is nominated for Best Men’s Futsal Club in the World, with its former coach Diego Rios nominated for Best Men’s Futsal Club Coach.
takeaways: Indonesia's national futsal team among nominees for Best Men’s National Futsal Team.
Hector Souto nominated as Best Men’s National Futsal Team Coach.
Bintang Timur Surabaya and Diego Rios nominated in club categories.
